newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria govt set to pick buyer for salt monopoly.
newsitem.headline: Austria govt set to pick buyer for salt monopoly.

text.p: The Austrian government's industrial holding company OeIAG said on Monday it was set to decide on a buyer for the state's salt monopoly Salinen AG later in the day.
"The sale is on our agenda today," a spokesman for OeIAG, which took over Salinen's business last August to prepare it for privatisation, said.

According to Austrian media reports, at least three offers have been made for Salinen, among them sugar and starch maker Agrana and former Finance Minister Hannes Androsch, who was said to have put up some 700 million schillings for the company and promised to invest 450 million schillings.
According to the reports, France's Salins du Midi, a unit of salt and chemicals group Morton International Inc is an outside runner for the salt monopoly. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
